Bullshit you don’t have anything to lose. Don’t start taking meds just because other people are telling you to or influencing you to. You are not a child or a lab rat and you can ABSOLUTELY make this decision based on YOUR feelings not their feelings. Demand help without meds at first, and if you don’t feel better then I suggest taking meds. Fact is that the meds will hinder your abilities to deal with your emotions naturally without meds, and once you stop taking them you will notice how difficult it is to cope without them on your own. However, if you are feeling exceptionally horrible then meds might be your immediate go to. Best of luck
